topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Questions with question words in the Simple Past
title: Simple Past: Wh-Questions

explanation.tr:
Soru kelimeli (Wh-) Simple Past soruları:
• Soru kelimesi + did + özne + yalın fiil?
  Where did you go? What did she buy? When did they arrive?
• 'be' ile: Soru kelimesi + was/were + özne?
  Where were you? Why was he angry?
• Özne soruları (Who/What özne ise) did almaz:
  Who called you? (✓) – Who did call you? (✗)
  What happened? (✓)
Soru kelimeleri: what, where, when, why, who, how, how long, how much.
explanation.tk:
Sorag sözli (Wh-) Simple Past soraglary:
• Sorag sözi + did + eýe + esasy işlik?
  Where did you go? What did she buy? When did they arrive?
• 'be' bilen: Sorag sözi + was/were + eýe?
  Where were you? Why was he angry?
• Eýe soraglary (Who/What eýe bolsa) did almaýar:
  Who called you? (✓) – Who did call you? (✗)
  What happened? (✓)
Sorag sözleri: what, where, when, why, who, how, how long, how much.
explanation.ru:
Специальные вопросы (Wh-) в Simple Past:
• Вопросительное слово + did + подлежащее + глагол?
  Where did you go? What did she buy? When did they arrive?
• С 'be': вопросительное слово + was/were + подлежащее?
  Where were you? Why was he angry?
• Вопросы к подлежащему (Who/What — подлежащее) без did:
  Who called you? (✓) – Who did call you? (✗)
  What happened? (✓)
Вопросительные слова: what, where, when, why, who, how, how long, how much.

examples.en: Where did you spend your holiday?
What did you have for dinner?

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Rules – Simple Past
title: Simple Past: All the Rules

explanation.tr:
Simple Past kuralları özeti:
1. Kullanım: geçmişte belli bir zamanda bitmiş eylemler (yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago).
2. Olumlu: düzenli fiil + -ed / düzensiz fiilin 2. hâli. Tüm öznelerde aynı.
3. Olumsuz: didn't + yalın fiil → I didn't go.
4. Soru: Did + özne + yalın fiil? → Did you go?
5. be: was / were; olumsuz wasn't / weren't; soru Was he...? Were they...?
6. Ard arda olan geçmiş olaylar: I got up, had breakfast and left.
-ed yazım: like → liked, cry → cried, play → played, plan → planned.
explanation.tk:
Simple Past düzgünleriniň jemi:
1. Ulanylyşy: geçmişde belli bir wagtda gutaran hereketler (yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago).
2. Tassyklaýjy: dogry işlik + -ed / nädogry işligiň 2-nji görnüşi. Ähli eýelerde birmeňzeş.
3. Ýokluk: didn't + esasy işlik → I didn't go.
4. Sorag: Did + eýe + esasy işlik? → Did you go?
5. be: was / were; ýokluk wasn't / weren't; sorag Was he...? Were they...?
6. Yzygiderli geçmiş wakalar: I got up, had breakfast and left.
-ed ýazylyşy: like → liked, cry → cried, play → played, plan → planned.
explanation.ru:
Сводка правил Simple Past:
1. Употребление: законченные действия в определённый момент прошлого (yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago).
2. Утверждение: правильный глагол + -ed / вторая форма неправильного. Одинаково для всех лиц.
3. Отрицание: didn't + начальная форма → I didn't go.
4. Вопрос: Did + подлежащее + начальная форма? → Did you go?
5. be: was / were; отрицание wasn't / weren't; вопрос Was he...? Were they...?
6. Последовательные события в прошлом: I got up, had breakfast and left.
Орфография -ed: like → liked, cry → cried, play → played, plan → planned.

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Sentences and questions in the Simple Past
title: Simple Past: Sentences and Questions Practice

explanation.tr:
Bu alıştırmada Simple Past'ta cümle ve soru kurmayı birlikte çalışacaksın.
• Olumlu: My friend called me yesterday.
• Olumsuz: My friend didn't call me yesterday.
• Evet/hayır sorusu: Did your friend call you yesterday?
• Wh- sorusu: When did your friend call you?
• Cevap verirken soruyla aynı zamanı kullan: Did you see it? – Yes, I saw it. / No, I didn't see it.
explanation.tk:
Bu gönükmede Simple Past-da sözlem we sorag düzmegi bilelikde türgenleşersiň.
• Tassyklaýjy: My friend called me yesterday.
• Ýokluk: My friend didn't call me yesterday.
• Hawa/ýok soragy: Did your friend call you yesterday?
• Wh- soragy: When did your friend call you?
• Jogap berlende sorag bilen şol bir zamany ulan: Did you see it? – Yes, I saw it. / No, I didn't see it.
explanation.ru:
В этом упражнении ты тренируешь утверждения и вопросы в Simple Past вместе.
• Утверждение: My friend called me yesterday.
• Отрицание: My friend didn't call me yesterday.
• Общий вопрос: Did your friend call you yesterday?
• Специальный вопрос: When did your friend call you?
• Отвечай в том же времени: Did you see it? – Yes, I saw it. / No, I didn't see it.

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Signal words in the Simple Past
title: Signal Words for the Simple Past

explanation.tr:
Simple Past'ı gösteren sinyal kelimeler, geçmişte belli bir zamanı işaret eder:
• yesterday, the day before yesterday
• last night / last week / last year
• ... ago: two days ago, a long time ago
• in + geçmiş yıl: in 1998, in 2015
• when I was a child, at that time, then
Bu kelimeler varsa Present Perfect değil Simple Past kullan:
• I saw him yesterday. (✓) – I have seen him yesterday. (✗)
explanation.tk:
Simple Past-y görkezýän alamat sözler geçmişde belli bir wagty aňladýar:
• yesterday, the day before yesterday
• last night / last week / last year
• ... ago: two days ago, a long time ago
• in + geçen ýyl: in 1998, in 2015
• when I was a child, at that time, then
Bu sözler bar bolsa, Present Perfect däl-de Simple Past ulan:
• I saw him yesterday. (✓) – I have seen him yesterday. (✗)
explanation.ru:
Слова-маркеры Simple Past указывают на определённое время в прошлом:
• yesterday, the day before yesterday
• last night / last week / last year
• ... ago: two days ago, a long time ago
• in + прошедший год: in 1998, in 2015
• when I was a child, at that time, then
Если есть такие слова — нужен Simple Past, а не Present Perfect:
• I saw him yesterday. (✓) – I have seen him yesterday. (✗)

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Simple Past – Negation of sentences in English
title: Simple Past: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
Simple Past'ta olumsuz cümle:
• didn't (did not) + yalın fiil: I didn't go. She didn't eat.
• Fiil yalın hâle döner: went → didn't go, saw → didn't see.
• 'be' fiilinde did kullanılmaz: wasn't / weren't
  I wasn't tired. They weren't at home.
• could → couldn't: I couldn't sleep.
Kısaltma konuşmada çok yaygındır: didn't, wasn't, weren't.
explanation.tk:
Simple Past-da ýokluk sözlem:
• didn't (did not) + esasy işlik: I didn't go. She didn't eat.
• Işlik esasy görnüşe dolanýar: went → didn't go, saw → didn't see.
• 'be' işliginde did ulanylmaýar: wasn't / weren't
  I wasn't tired. They weren't at home.
• could → couldn't: I couldn't sleep.
Gysgaltma gürleşikde örän ýaýran: didn't, wasn't, weren't.
explanation.ru:
Отрицание в Simple Past:
• didn't (did not) + начальная форма: I didn't go. She didn't eat.
• Глагол возвращается в начальную форму: went → didn't go, saw → didn't see.
• С 'be' did не используется: wasn't / weren't
  I wasn't tired. They weren't at home.
• could → couldn't: I couldn't sleep.
В речи обычно сокращают: didn't, wasn't, weren't.

examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night.
She didn't come to the party.
We weren't hungry.
